thread:
Ava Ramos: Heads up — I noticed ACME's Mar 18 embedding usage on their invoice is ~11% lower than expected. Expected ~2.8M units, invoice shows ~2.5M. Suspect ingestion gap between 2026-03-18T02:05Z and 2026-03-18T04:20Z. Can eng check? Query: https://internal.redwood/queries/ingest-gap-1796 :eyes:

Eli Chen: I checked kafka metrics. Consumer group `metering-processor-v2` lag spike around 02:10 UTC. Throughput dropped for ~45m.

Eli Chen: Consumer lag excerpt:
```
2026-03-18T01:55Z lag=10
2026-03-18T02:10Z lag=1100  <-- spike
2026-03-18T03:40Z lag=0
```

Priya Kapoor: SRE saw an autoscaler churn at 02:08 (node OOM then GC). Filed INC-2026-131. Leader election slowed processing.

Marco Diaz: ACME reached out to ask why numbers are lower. They expect higher. We need to confirm before replying.

Zoe Martinez: Finance question: if ingestion gap caused undercount, do we backfill ledger or apply credit? What's policy?

Ava Ramos: Policy: if ledger undercounts due to platform ingestion, we backfill and adjust next invoice for amounts < $5k. >$5k requires amendment/invoice. Need estimate of delta and time to backfill.

Eli Chen: Plan:
1) Reingest raw events from kafka offsets (we retain raw logs)
2) Recompute per-tenant embed aggregates
3) Write ledger adjustments + audit rows
4) Notify CSM + finance; decide invoice amendment if >$5k

Estimate: reingest+validate for single tenant ~2 hours. Dollar delta guessed ~$400.

Priya Kapoor: I can schedule the reingest in maintenance window. Low-risk read-only dry-run first.

Eli Chen: Offsets to reingest: topic `meter-events`, partitions 3-7, offsets 1245120-1249000. Dry-run command:
```
./tools/reingest --topic meter-events --start 1245120 --end 1249000 --filter tenant=acme-corp --dry-run
```
I'll post dry-run delta when done.

Ava Ramos: Approve dry-run. Prepare a one-paragraph message CSM can send: explain transient lag, we'll reprocess and reconcile ledger, no action needed from ACME.

Eli Chen: Dry-run results: delta = +309,842 embed units for acme-corp; projected charge +$433.78. Checksums match for reingested batch.

Zoe Martinez: <$5k, so we can backfill and adjust next invoice. Ava, finance approves proceeding.

Priya Kapoor: Starting write now with maintenance flag. ETA ~45m. Monitoring.

billing-bot: NOTE: Any ledger adjustments will generate audit event. Ensure `ledger-adjustment:reason` is set. KB: https://docs.redwood/internal/billing/ledger-adjustments

Eli Chen: Write completed. Audit ID ADJ-2026-8341. Ledger increased by +309,842 embed units for tenant acme-corp. Posting adjustment to invoice queue.

Zoe Martinez: Logged adjustment, will update invoice records and close reconciliation ticket. Revenue recognition unaffected until cash collection.

Marco Diaz: CSM-Leah to send message to ACME. Draft:
"We reprocessed a short window of telemetry and found missing usage; we've adjusted your usage ledger by +309,842 embed units. This will be reflected on your next invoice. If you'd prefer a one-off amendment, let us know and we'll escalate"

CSM-Leah: Message sent to ACME, they replied thanks. :thumbsup:

Ava Ramos: Thanks team. Closing once record updated. :white_check_mark:
